file_purpose: Research evidence profile for University of Nottingham A100 Medicine. This file captures official admissions evidence and non-executable FOI historical interview-shortlisting guidance. It is not a production admissions rules file.

research_scope.source_of_truth_policy: The supplied Markdown dossier is the single source of truth. Screenshots are used only to verify structured scoring tables and research-team-confirmed FOI historical guidance.
research_scope.cycle_caveat: The official Admissions Policy PDF covers 2026 entry. The live course page covers 2027 entry and contains some updated or inconsistent details. Every cycle-sensitive fact must retain its entry-year label, and the live Nottingham website must be checked for the cycle being advised on.

evidence_classification_policy.official: Evidence stated in the supplied dossier as originating from an official University of Nottingham source.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: Historical evidence confirmed by the research team to originate from official Freedom of Information responses. It is retained as historical guidance only.
evidence_classification_policy.research_gap: Information not officially available in the supplied evidence. No value is estimated or inferred.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_execution_policy: FOI historical ranges must not be treated as published fixed cut-offs, deterministic thresholds, eligibility rules, or executable production logic.

readiness.summary: Research and the scoped production handoff are complete for the supplied dossier and screenshots. Official eligibility, GCSE/UCAT/SJT scoring, combined ranking, contextual offers, interview process and published historical ranges are captured. FOI ranges are used only as historical guidance. A108.name: Medicine with a Foundation Year
A108.eligibility_scope: UK Home applicants meeting widening-participation/contextual criteria
not_open_to: EU applicants without qualifying Home status
applicants who have already studied at university

A101.name: Graduate Entry Medicine
A101.relationship_to_A100: A graduate may apply to A100 or A101, but not both in the same cycle.

graduate_applicants_to_A100.minimum_degree_profile: At least predicted or achieved 2:1, or 2:2 with a taught Master's at merit or above.
graduate_applicants_to_A100.application_restriction: May apply to A100 or A101, but not both in the same cycle.

deferred_entry.A101_exception: Deferred entry is not accepted for A101.

mature_applicants.policy: Mature applicants follow the applicable standard or graduate academic route.

minimum_age.requirement: Applicant must be 17 or older by 1 September in the year of entry.
minimum_age.under_18_requirement: A parent or legal guardian must complete the University consent form if the applicant is under 18 at registration.
minimum_age.excluded: Applicants who would be in their 16th year on 1 September are not considered.

common_requirements.gcse: Minimum six GCSEs at grade 7/A, including Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry or Double Science; minimum grade 6/B in Mathematics and English Language.
common_requirements.mathematics: GCSE Mathematics grade 6/B minimum or equivalent across routes, including the graduate route.
common_requirements.predicted_grades_policy: Predicted A-level or equivalent grades are not used in shortlisting or scoring. They are relevant only to the conditions of a subsequent offer.
common_requirements.practical_endorsement: A pass is required in science practical endorsement tests where assessed separately; it is not numerically scored.

a_level.sitting_policy: Three A levels must be passed at the required grades in one sitting.

conditions: A levels were completed within the last 12 months.
At least ABB was achieved at the first sitting.
The first sitting included an A in Biology or Human Biology, or Chemistry.
Resit grades meet AAA and include Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry.

international_baccalaureate.option_1: 34 points overall, including Higher Level grade 6 in Biology and Higher Level grade 6 in Chemistry.
international_baccalaureate.option_2: Three Higher Level certificates at 6,6,6, including grade 6 in Biology and grade 6 in Chemistry.

scottish_welsh_irish.official_direction: Other qualifications, including international qualifications, are considered and applicants should contact the University of Nottingham Recruitment and Admissions Team.

access_to_he.policy: BTEC Nationals and the Access to HE Diploma are not accepted for A100.
access_to_he.related_route_note: A qualifying Access to Medicine Diploma may be accepted for A108 only under its defined credit criteria.

graduate_A100.option_2: 2:2 honours degree with a taught Master's at merit or above.
graduate_A100.non_bioscience_requirement: A-level Biology grade B is required where the degree has insufficient biology content.
graduate_A100.mathematics_requirement: GCSE Mathematics grade 6/B minimum or equivalent.
graduate_A100.degree_completion: The degree must be completed in its natural length and ratified evidence must be supplied by the specified July deadline.
graduate_A100.application_restriction: Cannot apply to both A100 and A101 in the same cycle.

international.transcript_requirement: Applicants without a full GCSE or iGCSE history must provide a Year 10 or 11 transcript showing approximately six subjects, including Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics and English, at an equivalent standard.

gcse_resits.required_resit_grade: The resit must meet the original minimum: grade 6/B for Mathematics or English Language and grade 7/A for the specified sciences.

gcse_scoring.applies_to: A100 applicants with GCSE, iGCSE or accepted equivalent results
compulsory_components: Biology or Human Biology, or the applicable Double Science result
gcse_scoring.subject_weighting: All eight scored results are equally weighted. Science subjects receive no multiplier within the GCSE score.

official_worked_example.results: Five grade 8s, two grade 7s and one grade 6 in English Language.

gcse_scoring.contextual_adjustment: None. Contextual status does not change GCSE points.

applicants_without_gcse_or_equivalent.official_caveat: Nottingham states that these applicants are not disadvantaged.

ucat_scoring.test_timing: UCAT must be taken in the same year as the UCAS application.
ucat_scoring.official_threshold_caveat: Nottingham does not use a fixed score to select for interview. The threshold varies each year and cannot be predicted in advance. Nottingham states that it does not share previous years' interview thresholds through its published selection guidance.

applicant_group_application.home: Same A100 UCAT and SJT scoring process.
applicant_group_application.international: Same A100 UCAT and SJT scoring process.
applicant_group_application.graduate_A100: Same A100 UCAT and SJT scoring process.

ucat_scoring.related_A101_note: A101 uses GAMSAT for 2026 entry. A future move to UCAT was not confirmed on Nottingham's official current pages in the dossier and must not be treated as confirmed.

combined_ranking_methodology.formula: GCSE points + UCAT cognitive points + SJT points
combined_ranking_methodology.selection_action: Top-scoring applicants are invited until interview capacity is filled.
combined_ranking_methodology.cutoff_caveat: There is no fixed or published interview cut-off. The competitive threshold changes with applicant numbers and performance each year.

home_international_A100_pool_separation.dossier_observation: Separate Home and International place allocations and statistics are consistent with separate management, but the dossier identifies this as an inference rather than an explicitly published A100 pool rule.

foi_historical_interview_guidance.metric: Combined Nottingham pre-interview points on the 82-point GCSE plus UCAT scale
foi_historical_interview_guidance.scope: Historical ranges associated with interview shortlisting, split by applicant group.

provenance.research_team_confirmation: The historical ranges are confirmed by the research team to originate from official FOI responses.
provenance.evidence_supplied_in_this_intake: Secondary screenshot transcription; the underlying FOI response documents were not attached.

official_caveats: Nottingham does not publish a fixed interview threshold.
The threshold moves each year with the applicant pool and overall performance.
Historical ranges cannot predict a future threshold in advance.
The ranges are FOI historical guidance and are not a guarantee of interview selection.
Applicants without GCSE or equivalent results are scored on the 50-point UCAT scale, so the 82-point ranges must not be applied to them.

contextual_admissions_policy.scope: Eligible UK Home fee-status applicants meeting University of Nottingham contextual criteria.
contextual_admissions_policy.effect: Contextual status changes the academic grades required in an eventual offer after a successful interview; it does not alter the published GCSE and UCAT point formula.

standard_contextual.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

enhanced_contextual.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

elite_athletes.subject_condition: Same requirement for an A in Biology or Chemistry.

contextual_admissions_policy.A108_note: A108 is the dedicated foundation/widening-participation route for eligible applicants who do not meet standard A100 grades.
contextual_admissions_policy.non_A_level_equivalents: Contextual treatment of other equivalent qualifications is reviewed case by case.

assessed_qualities: Understanding of professional issues such as teamwork
Respect for the contribution of professions allied to medicine
interview_process.assessment_basis: Qualities are based on Medical Schools Council guidance.
interview_process.offer_stage_role: Interview performance is the sole scored determinant of offers.

delivery_mode.2026_entry: Expected to be entirely online using Microsoft Teams.
delivery_mode.2027_entry_home_page: Likely to be held in person.
delivery_mode.2027_entry_international_page: Refers to Microsoft Teams online delivery.

offer_process.ranking_basis: Applicants are ranked solely by total interview score after interview.
offer_process.tie_breaker: Where interview scores are identical, UCAT score is the primary differentiator for A100; GAMSAT is used for A101.
offer_process.near_miss_process: Conditional offer-holders who narrowly miss their grade terms may be reviewed in August if places remain unfilled. Decisions are communicated through UCAS.
conditions: Meet the grade requirements shown in UCAS Hub.
Satisfactory Disclosure and Barring Service clearance.
Satisfactory check against the Medical Schools Council Excluded Students Database.

historical_admissions_statistics.publication_format: Ranges across the past few years, not year-by-year figures.
historical_admissions_statistics.official_warning: Nottingham advises applicants not to base an application decision on previous-year data because applicant, interview and offer numbers change and may not represent the current competition.
not_published: Historical GCSE averages for successful applicants
Contextual or widening-participation applicant, interview and offer counts
Graduate applicants to A100 as a separate statistical group
A101 applicant, interview and offer ranges
